title: Strategic Customer Signal Gateway and Commitment Metering
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight gateway and scoring layer that ingests structured and unstructured strategic-customer signals (voice-of-customer, account escalations, enterprise support tickets, and exec asks) and produces a single Commitment Meter score to drive roadmap lanes and escalation handling. This ticket defines scope, data sources, scoring model, UI contract for Console intake, and rollout plan for a pilot with three strategic accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway ingests signals from Support, Customer Success, and Account Exec forms (via webhook or CSV) and normalizes into event schema
Commitment Meter algorithm produces a stable 0-100 score with documented factors and weights
Console exposes a read-only Commitment Meter card on Account pages and an intake channel for flagged signals
Pilot with 3 accounts demonstrated: at least one lane movement or explicit roadmap mention triggered by meter in 30 days
Telemetry exists: counts of signals ingested, meter changes, related roadmap commits linked to ticket IDs
notes: Not trying to replace existing intake forms today — this is an orchestration and prioritization layer that aggregates signals and surfaces a single operational metric
Score formula will be transparent to internal teams. We will iterate weights after pilot based on outcomes
We will not implement auto-promote or contractual SLAs in phase 1; those are follow-ups depending on pilot results
comments: 2026-02-22: Kickoff meeting — aligned on data sources (Zendesk, Intercom, CSM intake form, Sales Ops spreadsheet). Action: ENG to prototype webhook adapter (Marco)
2026-02-28: PM/CS sync — agreed on initial weight buckets: severity(40), revenue-tier(25), frequency(20), exec-ask(15). Action: build sample scoring notebook (link below)
2026-03-04: Design review — small Commitment Meter card mockups approved. Designer: Sanaa Idris to provide final assets by 2026-03-12
2026-03-08: Eng update — prototype adapter ingests sanitized Zendesk export and emits normalized events to staging topic (see PR #842 on GitHub)
2026-03-10: PM note — shifting pilot accounts to include an enterprise customer with complex compliance requests to validate private deployment signals
risks: Score could over-index on noisy signals leading to false positives — mitigated by rate-limited inputs and manual overrides
Operational burden on CSMs if meter produces too many flagged accounts — mitigate with sampling and thresholds for pilot
Privacy concerns for sensitive enterprise tickets — ensure ingestion adapters strip PII and follow KMS policies
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (pilot): build adapters and scoring prototype, enable read-only card for 3 pilot accounts (4 weeks)
Phase 2 (validate): collect outcome mappings (meter change -> roadmap action) and adjust weights (6 weeks)
Phase 3 (ops): add configurable thresholds, alerting to CSM workflow, and admin controls for manual adjustments (8 weeks)
Phase 4 (contractual): evaluate Dedicated/Private SLA integration and legal playbook (TBD after pilot)
open_questions: What is the canonical revenue tier field for scoring across Salesforce/HubSpot?
Do we treat exec-asks from email the same as flagged CS tickets?
Should Commitment Meter be editable by account owners or read-only?
